info.title: HMS clinical API v2
info.description: Implemented patient, encounter and clinical document commands. Clinical document fields depend on doc_type. Signatures expose the original canonical_signed_content; digest does not cover the snake_case presentation. Full clinical adapter coverage remains in the clinical completion checklist.
